latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of edge-tts-uvx.

- Provides text-to-speech audio generation using Microsoft Edge's neural TTS via the uvx edge-tts command-line tool.
- Supports multiple languages, a wide range of voices, and options for adjusting speed, pitch, and volume.
- Enables generation of speech subtitles.
- Includes usage instructions and a detailed list of available voices.
